semiconductor_relevance: Medium — NTT Docomo Business is involved in the semiconductor industry through its IOWN initiative, which focuses on innovative optical and wireless network solutions that can impact semiconductor utilization.
summary: NTT Docomo Business is showcasing its IOWN (Innovative Optical & Wireless Network) initiative at SEMICON, which includes research and development aimed at enhancing semiconductor applications. Their booth features three zones that highlight the IOWN concept, practical use cases, and ongoing R&D efforts relevant to the semiconductor sector.
